project_name: HENAN FANGCHENG AND TANGHE AFFORESTATION PROJECT
description: All sites were barren hills at least 10 years prior to the implementation of the project, the project will not convert native ecosystems to create GHG emission reductions or removals.The project is to establish forest on the barren hills to generate GHG emission reductions or removals and contribute to local sustainable development. The project is implemented by about 32,722.7 ha of forest is to be established by direct planting on barren hills in Fangcheng county and Tanghe county, Nanyang City, Henan Province.
project_category: Agriculture Forestry and Other Land Use
